info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupons API provides a comprehensive interface for retrieving available coupons that can be applied to customer shopping carts. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance the customer experience by displaying relevant promotional offers based on the current cart contents. Typical consumers include frontend developers looking to optimize the checkout process and marketing teams aiming to dynamically showcase coupons. By integrating this API, users can effectively manage and present discount opportunities, fostering greater customer engagement and potentially increasing sales.

get.summary: Retrieve active coupon information from the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current coupon details applied to the cart. Utilize this information to better understand discounts and promotions available for the items in your cart.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving coupon information in the shopping cart. The request body should contain the necessary parameters to identify the coupon the user is trying to apply.

ListEcommerceCartCouponsRequest.title: Cart Coupon Operations Request Body
ListEcommerceCartCouponsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting information related to a coupon in a shopping cart. The request body must be a string that describes the coupon.
